course_name_en: Industrial Measurement Engineering / Process Measurement and Sensor Technology
prerequisites: Fundamentals of measurement technology and electrical measurement technology at BSc level

learning_outcomes.text: Students will have broad and deep knowledge in the field of measuring non-electrical quantities.
They are able to design and optimize extensive measurement systems.
Students are able to develop devices and systems for measuring process variables.
Students can transfer the results of their work into practice.
Students learn the latest scientific results in the field of process measurement technology.
Students can discuss problems and tasks in the subject area.
Students learn to act scientifically and professionally.

syllabus_topics: Basic sensory principles for measuring non-electrical quantities, building on the fundamentals of measurement technology
Computer-aided treatment of non-linear characteristic curves
Computer-aided measurement data acquisition and processing

Approximation methods for calibration and their advantages and disadvantages in various metrological applications. Mathematical optimization possibilities for the calibration of measurement systems will be presented, with the aim of managing with a minimum of calibration standards or calibration substances while maintaining the quality of the measurement results.
assessment_rules: The graded examination is a written exam (Klausur). The ungraded examination is experimental work consisting of 6 experiments, each 90 minutes long. Specific duration and scope for the written exam are according to the valid study regulations.
